svg.aria-label: MUTAQIN ARYAWIJAYA. Applied ML and Software Engineer, Jakarta, Indonesia. Beside the name, an ASCII animation cycles through the work: construction plans, a phone call, a fruit fly, a flying car, a forecast, a drone, shared memory, a flock, a brain, and more, each with its field named underneath.
